Root.summary: V3 uses version, systemUnderTest, dependencies, proxies, mcp, specmatic and components. A file can configure only the operation you need.
Root.interaction: Inline services are supported. Named components are reusable declarations; declaring a component does not automatically select it for a run.
Root.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

Components.summary: Components hold reusable definitions. Select a service through systemUnderTest or dependencies to use its specs for testing or mocking.
Components.interaction: Component services and run options are interpreted in their use-site context. A component reused in incompatible test/mock contexts can fail typed conversion.
Components.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

ContextService.summary: Components hold reusable definitions. Select a service through systemUnderTest or dependencies to use its specs for testing or mocking.

Reference.summary: A reference identifies reusable configuration. Local component refs use #/components/<collection>/<name>.
Reference.interaction: Sibling properties replace matching properties on the referenced object with a shallow merge. Replacing a nested settings object does not preserve its omitted child fields. Internal component resolution does not support array indices or JSON Pointer escape decoding.
Reference.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

TestService.summary: The system under test supplies the specifications and execution settings for testing a real service.
TestService.interaction: Service settings override global test settings field by field. Run options select protocol targets; data supplies examples and dictionaries.

TestSettings.summary: Service test settings override specmatic.settings.test field by field.

TestSettings.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

MockSettings.summary: Service settings override dependency-wide settings, which override global mock settings.
MockSettings.interaction: Global startup timeout defaults to 20 seconds; generative mocks default to false. Startup/hot-reload/restart getters use dependency/global settings. Other defaults must be checked per runner.
MockSettings.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

GeneralSettings.summary: General settings are used by shared parsers, matching, logging and lifecycle code.
GeneralSettings.interaction: They can affect tests, mocks and validation. Telemetry uses environment/property precedence and disabling is retained for the lifetime of the process. Pretty printing defaults to enabled.
GeneralSettings.evidence: Configuration codebase reference, behavior guide; schema facts are recorded separately.

AdapterConfiguration.summary: Adapter entries are literal hook names mapped to commands/scripts.
